title: Gameplay tunables
description: All magic numbers used by gameplay code (CLAUDE.md Section 6). Loaded through sim/tuning.gd and read with dotted paths, e.g. Tuning.value("net.tick_hz").

arrive_radius.description: Within this range the go-to target counts as reached.

brake_margin.description: Safety factor padding the computed flip-and-burn braking distance; higher starts braking earlier.

turn_gain.description: Proportional rudder gain on heading error in radians.

thrust_cone_deg.description: Thrust only while heading error is inside this cone.

heading_deadzone_deg.description: Rudder stays centered for heading errors under this; stops micro-hunting.

thrust_softness.description: Speed deficit (units/s) at which thrust reaches full; lower is snappier, higher is smoother.

starter_hull_id.description: Hull every new ship spawns with until starbases sell hulls (M2). Must match a data/ships/<id>.json file (checked by validate_data.py).

spawn_ring_radius.description: Radius of the ring new ships spawn on.

tick_hz.description: Fixed sim tick rate for the server AND client prediction. 20 per CLAUDE.md Section 5.

intent_timeout_ms.description: A ship whose peer sends no intent for this long is treated as idle (dead-man's switch for frozen or lossy clients).

snap_correction_dist.description: Prediction error beyond this many units snaps instead of blending.

view_blend_rate.description: Exponential blend rate (1/s) of ship views toward the latest network state; higher is snappier.

reconcile_blend.description: Fraction of the prediction error corrected per snapshot when under snap_correction_dist.

pitch_deg.description: 30 gives the 2:1 classic iso read (CLAUDE.md Section 4).

zoom_levels.description: Orthographic camera size per zoom step. Zoom changes size, never position.

camera_distance.description: How far back along the view axis the camera sits. Cosmetic only under ortho.
